adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff adds `total = group.users.count` and then performs a separate `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)` query. This means each members-page request now issues an additional COUNT(*) query (likely over the group/users association) to populate `meta.total`, and this will be repeated for each pagination request (`limit/offset` clicks). This is a performance/scalability concern grounded in the new code, not a functional correctness defect.
